<html>
<head>
	<link href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap@5.3.3/dist/css/bootstrap.min.css" rel="stylesheet" integrity="sha384-QWTKZyjpPEjISv5WaRU9OFeRpok6YctnYmDr5pNlyT2bRjXh0JMhjY6hW+ALEwIH" crossorigin="anonymous">
	<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap@5.3.3/dist/js/bootstrap.bundle.min.js" integrity="sha384-YvpcrYf0tY3lHB60NNkmXc5s9fDVZLESaAA55NDzOxhy9GkcIdslK1eN7N6jIeHz" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>
	<script src="https://cdn.plot.ly/plotly-latest.min.js"></script>

	<style>
	.uni {
		color: hotpink !important;
		font-weight: bold !important;
	}
	.leg {
		font-weight: bold !important;
		background-color: orange !important;
	}
	.epi {
		font-weight: bold !important;
		background-color: #ffff00 !important;
	}
	.beg {
		font-weight: bold !important;
		background-color: deepskyblue !important;
	}

	#SetItemsInfo th, #SetItemsInfo td, #SetItemsInfo tr {
		font-size: 13px;
	}

    #SetItemsInfo tbody tr:nth-child(odd) {
        border-top: 1.5px solid blue;
    }

    #SetItemsInfo tbody td:nth-last-child(8) {
		border-left: 1.5px solid black;
	}

	</style>
</head>
<body>
    <div class="container mt-4">
        <h3 class="text-center">{{CharInfo}}</h3>
        
        <div class="row mt-4">
            <div class="col-md-4">
                <table class="table table-bordered text-center">
                    <thead>
                        <tr>
                            <th>등급</th>
                            <th class="uni">유니크</th>
                            <th class="leg">레전더리</th>
                            <th class="epi">에픽</th>
                            <th class="beg">태초</th>
                        </tr>
                    </thead>
                </table>
            </div>
        </div>

        <div class="row mt-3">
            <div class="col-md-12">
                <table class="table table-striped table-hover text-center">
                    <thead>
                        <tr>
                            <th>적용포인트</th>
                            <th class="uni">1200</th>
                            <th class="uni">1285</th>
                            <th class="uni">1370</th>
                            <th class="uni">1455</th>
                            <th class="uni">1540</th>
                            <th class="leg">1650</th>
                            <th class="leg">1735</th>
                            <th class="leg">1820</th>
                            <th class="leg">1905</th>
                            <th class="leg">1990</th>
                            <th class="epi">2100</th>
                            <th class="epi">2185</th>
                            <th class="epi">2270</th>
                            <th class="epi">2355</th>
                            <th class="epi">2440</th>
                            <th class="beg">2550</th>
                        </tr>
                    </thead>
                </table>
            </div>
        </div>

        <p class="text-right">조회 : {{SearchTime}}</p>

        <div class="row mt-4">
            <div class="col-md-4">
                <a href="https://dfmax.xyz/character/{{ServerId}}/{{CharKey}}" class="btn btn-warning w-100" target="_blank">DFMAX 링크</a>
            </div>
            <div class="col-md-4">
                <a href="https://dundam.xyz/character?server={{ServerId}}&key={{CharKey}}" class="btn btn-primary w-100" target="_blank">DUNDAM 링크</a>
            </div>
        </div>

        <div class="card mt-4 shadow-sm">
            <div class="row g-0">
                <div class="col-md-3 text-center p-3">
                    <img src="https://img-api.neople.co.kr/df/servers/{{ServerId}}/characters/{{CharKey}}/" class="img-fluid rounded" alt="캐릭터 이미지">
                    <p class="mt-2">{{CharSummary}}</p>
                </div>
                <div class="col-md-9">
                    <div class="card-body">
                        <h5 class="card-title">{{UseItemTitleSummary}}</h5>
                        <table class="table table-striped table-bordered">
                            <thead>
                                <tr>
                                    <th>아이템</th>
                                    <th>장비</th>
                                    <th>강화/증폭</th>
                                    <th>이름</th>
                                    <th>등급</th>
                                    <th>조율</th>
                                </tr>
                            </thead>
                            {{UseItemSummary}}
                        </table>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>

        <h3 class="mt-5 text-center">세트별 가능 등급 (기본 유니크)</h3>
        <h5 class="text-center text-muted">장비는 기본 유니크 착용을 기준으로 계산, 융합석은 착용중인 세트가 있을 때 기준으로 계산</h5>

        <div class="table-responsive mt-4">
            <table class="table table-bordered text-center" id="SetItemsInfo">
                <thead>
                    <tr>
                        <th rowspan="2">세트명</th>
                        <th rowspan="2">구분</th>
                        <th colspan="11">장비</th>
                        <th colspan="5">융합석</th>
                        <th rowspan="2">point</th>
                        <th rowspan="2">세트등급</th>
                        <th rowspan="2">다음등급<br/>필요포인트</th>
                    </tr>
                    <tr>
                        <th>어깨</th><th>상의</th><th>하의</th><th>벨트</th><th>신발</th>
                        <th>팔찌</th><th>목걸이</th><th>보조장비</th><th>반지</th><th>귀걸이</th><th>마법석</th>
                        <th>어깨</th><th>상의</th><th>하의</th><th>벨트</th><th>신발</th>
                    </tr>
                </thead>
                {{AvailableSetItem}}
            </table>
        </div>

        
        <div>
            <table>
		        <tr>
			        <td>
				        <div id="rarityPlot" style="width:100%;max-width:500px"></div>

				        <script>
				        const rarityXArray = {{RarityX}};
				        const rarityYArray = {{RarityY}};

				        const rarityLayout = {title:"획득 정보 합"};

				        const rarityData = [{
					        labels:rarityXArray, 
					        values:rarityYArray, 
					        type:"pie", 
					        textinfo: 'label+value',
					        //marker: {
					        //	colors: ['deepskyblue', 'yellow', 'orange']
					        //}
				        }];

				        Plotly.newPlot("rarityPlot", rarityData, rarityLayout);
				        </script>
			        </td>
			        <td>
				        <div id="channelPlot" style="width:100%;max-width:700px"></div>

				        <script>
				        const channelXArray = {{ChannelX}};
				        const channelYArray = {{ChannelY}};

				        const channelLayout = {title:"획득 정보 채널 TOP 10"};

				        const channelData = [{labels:channelXArray, values:channelYArray, type:"pie", textinfo: 'label+value'}];

				        Plotly.newPlot("channelPlot", channelData, channelLayout);
				        </script>
			        </td>
		        </tr>
	        </table>

        </div>

        <div>
            <table>
		        <tr>
			        <td>
				        <div id="hellPlot" style="width:100%;max-width:400px"></div>

				        <script>
				        const hellXArray = {{HellX}};
				        const hellYArray = {{HellY}};

				        const hellLayout = {title:"획득 정보 종말"};

				        const hellData = [{labels:hellXArray, values:hellYArray, type:"pie", textinfo: 'label+value'}];

				        Plotly.newPlot("hellPlot", hellData, hellLayout);
				        </script>
			        </td>
			        <td>
				        <div id="spHellPlot" style="width:100%;max-width:400px"></div>

				        <script>
				        const spHellXArray = {{SpHellX}};
				        const spHellYArray = {{SpHellY}};

				        const spHellLayout = {title:"획득 정보 심연 : 종말"};

				        const spHellData = [{labels:spHellXArray, values:spHellYArray, type:"pie", textinfo: 'label+value'}];

				        Plotly.newPlot("spHellPlot", spHellData, spHellLayout);
				        </script>
			        </td>
			        <td>
				        <div id="weeklyPlot" style="width:100%;max-width:400px"></div>

				        <script>
				        const weeklyXArray = {{WeeklyX}};
				        const weeklyYArray = {{WeeklyY}};

				        const weeklyLayout = {title:"획득 정보 주간던전"};

				        const weeklyData = [{labels:weeklyXArray, values:weeklyYArray, type:"pie", textinfo: 'label+value'}];

				        Plotly.newPlot("weeklyPlot", weeklyData, weeklyLayout);
				        </script>
			        </td>
		        </tr>
	        </table>

        </div>
    

        <h3 class="mt-5 text-center">획득 정보 (레전더리 이상)</h3>
        {{ListSetItem}}
    

	    <img src="data:image/png;base64,">

    </div>
</body>
</html>
